Shroom Capsule Common Names: Japanese mountain priest, monkey head mushroom, bearded tooth mushroom, satyr’s beard, bearded hedgehog mushroom, pom pom mushroom and bearded tooth fungus.

Lions Mane shrooms capsule | Lion’s Mane Extract – 120 Capsules

Lion’s Mane (Hericium Erinaceus) supports mental clarity, focus and memory. The real mushrooms lion’s mane extract mushroom is also called the “smart mushroom, nature’s nutrient for the neurons”. Research has shown that it stimulates the production of nerve growth factor (NGF) in the brain.

Ingredients per vegetarian capsule: 400 mg organic Lions’ Mane (Hericium Erinaceus) extract of 100% fruiting body (mushroom). It is a full spectrum extract obtained by means of H2O and ethanol. This is to get the most out of the fruiting bodies. It contains 30% polysaccharides and beta-glucans

Excipients Magnesium Citrate and Silicon Dioxide

Microdose Shroom Capsules Can provide assistance with:

– Development of neurons in the brain through connections that the Lion’s Mane knows how to make.

– Lion’s Mane provides support in optimizing your learning ability and performance (natural nootropic).

– Through regular use, Lion’s Mane contributes to concentration and focus.

– Supports the building of a strong memory, stimulates it and provides clarity.

– Lion’s Mane can contribute to a stronger immune system

Shroom capsules warning:

Keep out of reach of children.

Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have health problems.

This is a dietary supplement and should be use as such.
